page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.24xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8559C processor with 96 vCPUs, 48 physical cores, and a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes a 320 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for tile and INT8 operations. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core.

For local storage, the instance bundles 60,000 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. In benchmark evaluations, the i7ie.24xlarge demonstrates top-tier performance, achieving top 10% placement in Geekbench multi-core scores, Passmark CPU tests, and static web serving throughput. Memory bandwidth and database operations, including Redis SET operations, rank in the top 25% tier.

Given the high density of both DDR5 memory and local NVMe SSD storage, this instance offers high resource density for data-intensive applications. It is designed for workloads requiring massive local storage and high-throughput memory access, such as large-scale databases, data warehousing, real-time analytics, and high-performance web serving.
